newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil seen 50 cts to $1.00 lower, Brent level.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil seen 50 cts to $1.00 lower, Brent level.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures were seen mildly lower at the open, weighed down by a weaker NYMEX close with traders cautious ahead of next week's OPEC meeting.
July gas oil was expected to slip 50 cents to $1.00 from its prior close of $159.50 a tonne. August Brent was seen unchanged from its closing price of $17.78 a barrel.
In a market driven largely by technicals, dealers said prices would likely track movements in NYMEX crude on ACCESS.
NYMEX crude oil had recovered three cents to $18.70 a barrel by 0745 GMT in what dealers said could allow for gas oil and Brent to move a little higher later as well.
"We've had two days of trading in almost the same range and we should stay there assuming OPEC (members) are arriving for fun and games this weekend," one dealer said.
That range for August IPE Brent was $17.68 to $17.98.
They said the market was unlikely to move much as trade thinned out ahead of an OPEC ministerial meeting in Vienna, officially scheduled to begin on June 25.

With market players, in particular investment funds, eager not to get their fingers burned after the market slipped to a new 13-month low last week of $17.32 on the spot continuation chart, few people were prepared to take large positions in advance of the meeting.
The August contract's low last week was $17.61
